_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Cloudflare http_request_cache_settings ruleset fronting the TC-ATLAS API (api.tcatlas.org). Apply with `python3 cloudflare/apply_cache_ruleset.py`; verify with `cloudflare/verify_cache.sh`. The auth token lives in GCP Secret Manager (secret `cloudflare-rules-token`); the zone_id/ruleset_id below are identifiers, not secrets. See README.md for the design rationale and CF API gotchas.

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE slow-changing JSON (active-storms, season-summary, ALL weatherlab-genesis* incl the ~20MB immutable spaghetti, weatherlab-global) respect origin max-age. The genesis base + global payloads were previously bypassed (DYNAMIC) so every global-map visitor pulled them from Cloud Run origin; the origin already stamps them immutable/short max-age so edge-caching is safe and cuts origin egress. EXCEPTION: /weatherlab-genesis-cycles (the cycle-picker list) AND /weatherlab-genesis-near (a per-lat/lon dynamic proximity lookup) are excluded so they fall through to DYNAMIC; both are tiny so the extra origin hits are negligible, and -near must not be edge-cached by-URL because it is a live spatial query. ALSO caches /recon/realtime: the origin already stamps it public,max-age=45,s-maxage=45,stale-while-revalidate=60 (the live recon HDOB/dropsonde feed for a storm, ~125 KB/call) but rule 2 was overriding it to DYNAMIC, so during an active recon mission every poll from every viewer hit the Cloud Run origin. Edge-caching collapses N concurrent pollers to ~1 origin pull per 45s per colo. respect_origin keeps the endpoint in control: if it ever returns no-store, CF auto-bypasses again. Vary: Origin is present so CORS variants cache per-origin. 2026-07-23 additions (all already stamp public,max-age at origin but were DYNAMIC): /surface-obs* (viewport/history, max-age=300-600), /env/layers (120), the live-TDR trio /realtime/{center_track,dropsondes,tilt_profile} (45-300), the three /microwave *overpasses endpoints + /microwave/nrt-storm-passes + /microwave/data, and /ascat/ (passes+winds).
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (http.request.uri.path contains "/active-storms" or http.request.uri.path contains "/season-summary" or (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis" and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "-cycles") and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "-near")) or http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-global" or http.request.uri.path contains "/recon" or http.request.uri.path contains "/surface-obs" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/env/layers") or http.request.uri.path contains "/realtime/center_track" or http.request.uri.path contains "/realtime/dropsondes" or http.request.uri.path contains "/realtime/tilt_profile" or http.request.uri.path contains "overpasses" or http.request.uri.path contains "/microwave/nrt-storm-passes" or http.request.uri.path contains "/microwave/data" or http.request.uri.path contains "/ascat/")

rules.description: tc-atlas: BYPASS live/no-store endpoints (per-storm /weatherlab + /weatherlab-ensemble, shear). All /weatherlab-genesis* and /weatherlab-global are EXCLUDED here so they fall through to the CACHE rule above. NOTE: /recon MOVED to the respect-origin CACHE rule above (the origin already declares max-age=45; this BYPASS was overriding it). Non-GET /recon still bypasses via the method!=GET clause, and respect_origin means any no-store recon response auto-bypasses anyway.
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (http.request.method ne "GET" or (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab" and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis" or http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-global")) or http.request.uri.path contains "/shear")

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE frame endpoints (respect origin max-age)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "band-raw-frame") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "ir-raw-frame") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "ir-frame.jpg"))

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE cdn JSON manifests + immutable genesis payloads (.json not in CF default extension set -> was DYNAMIC; mosaic frames.json + rt raw-frames manifest.json send max-age=60; /genesis/*.json are content-addressed per-cycle & immutable/max-age=86400 -> the ~23MB DeepMind spaghetti was re-pulled from R2 origin by EVERY global-map visitor because the edge would not cache it). 2026-07-23: added */index.json — the per-frame pack index (immutable, max-age=604800, references a content-hashed pack file) was DYNAMIC, so after the MOSAIC_PACK=only cutover EVERY viewer's EVERY frame paid an R2 origin RTT for its index; under load some of those fetches stalled, and the frontend's memoized index promise turned one stall into a permanently blank mosaic (fixed client-side the same day with a timeout + retry).
rules.expression: (http.host eq "cdn.tcatlas.org") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/frames.json") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/manifest.json") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/index.json") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/genesis/") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".json")))
